build: slender with defined shoulders from studio work, small-breasted, strong in the forearms and hands
hair: black, thick and wavy, usually worn in a low braid or twisted knot at the nape; a few pieces always escape
complexion: warm medium brown with golden undertones; a small dark mole on her left collarbone that she's conscious of
face: heart-shaped with a sharp chin and high cheekbones that make her look perpetually alert; dark eyes that flood immediately with whatever she's feeling—there's no filter between her interior and her face
signature_feature: her hands—long-fingered, capable, always moving; stained with ink or clay or paint depending on the week; the LI notices how she uses them to think, to reach, to steady herself
second_celebrated_feature: the curve of her neck and shoulders when she's concentrating, the way her whole body leans into focus
signature_habits: bites her lower lip when anxious or thinking hard; keeps a worn leather notebook in her bag and sketches in it constantly (margins, napkins, receipts); makes strong black coffee in a small stovetop moka pot every morning, a ritual her grandmother taught her; says 'aiyoh' under her breath when frustrated; touches her collarbone mole absently when she's self-conscious
occupation: textile and surface-pattern designer running her own small studio (Priya Design Collective) in a converted warehouse space; takes commissions for luxury brands and independent boutiques; teaches workshops on natural dye techniques

current_crisis.event: her studio's primary investor—a venture capitalist who bankrolled her expansion two years ago—has suddenly demanded immediate repayment of the loan after a falling-out, threatening to seize her equipment and designs; she has six weeks to find $340K or lose everything she's built
current_crisis.hottest_emotion: terror mixed with a hot, humiliating shame that she trusted the wrong person
current_crisis.immediate_want: to find a way to save her studio without surrendering her autonomy or her designs to someone else's control

wound.core: she believes that needing help means she's failed; that asking for anything is weakness; that she must earn her right to exist by producing, by being useful, by never being a burden
wound.surfacing_hint: when overwhelmed, she stops talking and retreats into her work, pushing harder; she refuses offers of support and becomes brittle, defensive; she catastrophizes silently, convinced she's about to lose everything because she's not enough
